cards.text: The LORD is speaking through Isaiah the prophet, and He calls out to everyone who pursues righteousness and seeks Him. His first move? He tells them to LOOK. Look back at the rock you were cut from, the quarry you were hewn from.

cards.question: The LORD tells His people to look to the rock and the quarry they came from. In that picture, His people are like what?
That rock they were cut from is a person. The LORD tells His people to look to ___ their father.

cards.text: That's Abraham, Israel's father, and Sarah, his wife. When the LORD called Abraham, he was but one: party of ONE, table for ONE, friend.

cards.question: Abraham was just one man when the LORD called him. What did the LORD do with him?

answers.text: Made him king over the nations

cards.text: Next comes a promise: the LORD will comfort Zion and look with compassion on all her ruins. I know a little something about being a ruin, friend. Just ask my old edges.

cards.question: The LORD will make Zion's desert like the garden of the LORD. What will He make her wilderness like?
Once the LORD comforts Zion, the sound of mourning will fill her streets.

cards.text: Then it's pay attention, My people, listen, My nation, because something is about to go out from Him. He says listen the way I say the oven's HOT: more than once, and with FEELING.

cards.question: The LORD says a ___ will go out from Him, and His justice will become a light to the nations.
The LORD says He will bring His justice about slowly, over many ages.

cards.text: His righteousness draws near, His salvation is on the way, and His arms will bring justice to the nations. Even the islands far away are in on this.

cards.question: The LORD's salvation is on the way. What do the faraway islands do?

answers.text: Look for Him and wait in hope
Hide from Him and turn away
Forget Him and go their way

cards.text: Now look up at the heavens and down at the earth: the heavens will vanish like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Wearing out like a garment? That was me in the back of that drawer, edges so worn my cookies came out looking like CLOUDS.

cards.question: The heavens will vanish and the earth will wear out, but the LORD's ___ will last forever.

cards.text: Then He speaks to people with His law in their hearts: don't fear the scorn of men, and don't be broken by their insults. I shared that drawer with an expired coupon that got insulted by every receipt in there, and that coupon STILL believed in itself.

cards.question: Why shouldn't the LORD's people fear the ones insulting them?

answers.text: The moth will devour them like a garment
The LORD will make them friends again
Their words will soon be forgotten

cards.question: The LORD says His salvation will last through all generations.

cards.text: Now a new voice calls out to the LORD: 'Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD.' The speaker asks Him to wake up as in days past, and starts remembering what that arm has done.
"Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?" Friend, I JUMP when the oven timer goes off, and this arm is out here piercing DRAGONS.

cards.question: The speaker remembers the LORD drying up the sea, the waters of the great deep. What did He make in the depths of that sea?

answers.text: A road for the redeemed to cross over
A home for the creatures of the deep
A wall to hold back the enemy

cards.text: And here's where it's all headed: the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing.

cards.question: The redeemed come into Zion singing. What are they crowned with?
When the redeemed enter Zion, sorrow and sighing will flee.

cards.text: Sorrow and sighing take off RUNNING, and I spent years in that drawer as a professional sigher. Then the LORD speaks: "I, even I, am He who comforts you."

cards.question: The LORD asks why His people should be afraid of mortal man, a son of man who withers like ___.

cards.text: But the LORD says they've forgotten Him, their Maker, the One who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth.

cards.question: The LORD's people have forgotten their Maker. How does the LORD say they live?

cards.text: Then the LORD asks about the oppressor they're so scared of: "But where is the fury of the oppressor?" Friend, I once spent a whole week in that drawer scared of a shadow that turned out to be a RUBBER BAND.

cards.question: The LORD says the captive will soon be ___ and will not die in the dungeon.
The LORD says the freed captive's bread will not be lacking.

cards.text: Then the LORD says who He is: the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. The LORD of Hosts is His name.
He says He has put His words in your mouth and covered you with the shadow of His hand. And it all builds to one thing He says to Zion.

cards.question: After all the comfort and all the promises, what does the LORD say to Zion?
